used.unit_availability: injury-report Out/Doubtful (+0.5 x Questionable) counts by unit from the historical final-weekly-report proxy (A2); positions from the static players table. No starter identities are reconstructed.

not_used_and_why.participation_offense_players / defense_: realized same-game participation (post-game); forbidden as a pregame input; also unpublished for 2026
not_used_and_why.snap_counts: realized same-game snaps; usable only as history through prior weeks
not_used_and_why.weekly_roster status: game-day snapshot (A3); T-90m only, and cannot identify offensive-line starters
not_used_and_why.depth_charts: timestamped snapshots exist for 2025+ (dt <= cutoff) and could give OL starters, but the tables carry no 2023-24 snapshots, so any OL-starter feature could only be fit on the 2025 development weeks (leaves nothing out-of-time); NOT used
not_used_and_why.ftn box / blitz (2026): FTN charting continues through 2026 and feeds the scheme profile through prior weeks only (via nfl_context_v4.def_profile)
not_used_and_why.man/zone, coverage, pressure (2026): participation is unpublished for 2026; def_profile falls back to the prior season for coverage-type rates (stale but as-of legal)

limitation: OL quality (pass-block win rate, run-block grades) is not available from a timestamp-safe pregame source in this repository; the personnel family measures only reported absences.
